root_causes.description: Frontend pods experiencing extreme restart activity (z>1000) combined with dramatically lower-than-baseline memory (z=-681.48) and CPU (z=-11.21) usage, indicating OOM kill and rapid restart cycle that cascades failures to all downstream services per the service topology.

remediation_steps: Investigate OOM events on frontend pods: kubectl describe pod <frontend-pod> -n otel-demo, check kube_pod_container_status_messages
Increase frontend resource limits or optimize application memory footprint to prevent OOM kills
Rollout updated frontend deployment with higher memory requests/limits once OOM root cause is addressed
Monitor pod restart rates and set alert on z-score >3 for early detection
